37900.commentary: (PYt) nissāya te vatthabban'ti niyassīyati bālo bhajāpīyati anena vinayakammenā'ti niyassaṃ, div'ādi-gaṇikattā sakārassa dvebhāvo hoti nassaṃ vassan'ti-ādīsu viya, niyassam'eva kammaṃ niyassakammaṃ.

examples.text: hand'assa mayaṃ niyassakammaṃ paṭippassambhemā'ti. te tassa niyassakammaṃ paṭippassambhenti

37901.meaning2: dealt with by the legal act of demotion

examples.text: yo, bhikkhave, ime dhamme evaṃ saddahati adhimuccati, ayaṃ vuccati saddh'ānusārī, okkanto sammattaniyāmaṃ, sappurisabhūmiṃ okkanto, vītivatto puthujjanabhūmiṃ.

37903.commentary: (ANa) niyāmaṃ kusalesu dhammesu sammattan'ti kusalesu dhammesu magganiyāmasaṅkhātaṃ sammattaṃ.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo labhanto vā tathāgataṃ dassanāya alabhanto vā tathāgataṃ dassanāya, labhanto vā tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ savanāya alabhanto vā tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ savanāya n'eva okkamati niyāmaṃ kusalesu dhammesu sammattaṃ.

yassa kho, bhikkhave, ime dhammā evaṃ paññāya mattaso nijjhānaṃ khamanti, ayaṃ vuccati, dhamm'ānusārī, okkanto sammattaniyāmaṃ, sappurisabhūmiṃ okkanto, vītivatto puthujjanabhūmiṃ, abhabbo taṃ kammaṃ kātuṃ, yaṃ kammaṃ katvā nirayaṃ vā tiracchānayoniṃ vā pettivisayaṃ vā upapajjeyya, abhabbo ca tāva kālaṃ kātuṃ yāva na sot'āpattiphalaṃ sacchikaroti.

37904.synonym: ākāra, upāya, ñāya, nīhāra, pakāra, patha, pariyāya, magga, vidhi

examples.text: itaro pucchitabbaniyāmen'eva pañhaṃ pucchitvā'pi tassa kathāya, apañhaṃ nu kho pucchitan'ti vimatiṃ karoti.

37908.meaning1: who has reached and seen the fixed order
37908.commentary: (SNa) ye niyāmagataddasā'ti ye niyāmagatā c'eva niyāmadassā'ti ca.

examples.text: bahunnaṃ vata atthāya, bodhiṃ ajjhagamā muni, bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīnañ'ca, ye niyāmagataddasā.
api ca samaṇo gotamo bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ tathaṃ paṭipadaṃ paññapeti dhammaṭṭhitataṃ dhammaniyāmataṃ.

37911.grammar: ind, adv, instr sg of niyāma
37911.meaning1: according to the correct method; in the prescribed manner

examples.text: itaro pucchitabbaniyāmen'eva pañhaṃ pucchitvā'pi tassa kathāya, apañhaṃ nu kho pucchitan'ti vimatiṃ karoti.

37912.commentary: (THa) itissu maṃ, citta, pure niyuñjasī'ti evañ'hi tvaṃ, citta, maṃ pabbajjato pubbe sammāpaṭipattiyaṃ uyyojesī'ti attho.

examples.text: mayūrakoñc'ābhirutamhi kānane, dīpīhi byagghehi purakkhato vasaṃ, kāye apekkhaṃ jaha mā virādhaya, itissu maṃ citta pure niyuñjasi.
app'icchatā sappurisehi vaṇṇitā, makkhappahānaṃ vūpasamo dukhassa, iti'ssu maṃ citta tadā niyuñjasi, idāni tvaṃ gacchasi pubbaciṇṇaṃ.
piyo garu bhāvanīyo, vattā ca vacanakkhamo, gambhīrañc'a kathaṃ kattā, no c'aṭṭhāne niyojaye.

37921.commentary: (PVa) ye maṃ niyojeyyun'ti mātā vā pitā vā atha vā ñātakā edisā pasannacittā hutvā samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ dadāhi dānan'ti ye maṃ niyojeyyuṃ, tādisā anukampakā mayhaṃ n'āhesun'ti yojanā.

examples.text: katamehi sattahi? piyo ca hoti manāpo ca garu ca bhāvanīyo ca vattā ca vacanakkhamo ca gambhīrañc'a kathaṃ kattā hoti, no ca aṭṭhāne niyojeti. imehi kho, bhikkhave, sattahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu mitto sevitabbo bhajitabbo payirupāsitabbo api panujjamānena'pī'ti.
anukampakā mayhaṃ n'āhesuṃ bhante, pitā ca mātā athavā'pi ñātakā, ye maṃ niyojeyyuṃ dadāhi dānaṃ, pasannacittā samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ.

37922.meaning2: having urged, having incited, having committed

37925.meaning2: is led, guided or conducted, is carried

examples.text: so bajjhataṃ pāsasatehi chabbhi, rammā vanā niyyatu rājadhāniṃ, tuttehi so haññatu pācanehi, bhisāni te brāhmaṇa yo ahāsi.
nirāsatti anāgate, atītaṃ n'ānusocati, vivekadassī phassesu, diṭṭhīsu ca na niyyati.

37926.meaning2: is gone out, is got out of

examples.text: atha kho vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamah'āmatto dārugahe gaṇakaṃ bandhaṃ āṇāpesi. addasa kho āyasmā dhaniyo kumbhakāraputto dārugahe gaṇakaṃ bandhaṃ niyyamānaṃ.
idha me, bho gotama, yaṃ ahosi dhanaṃ vā dhaññaṃ vā rajataṃ vā jātarūpaṃ vā sabbaṃ taṃ puttānaṃ dāyajjaṃ niyyātaṃ, tatth'āhaṃ anovādī anupavādī ghāsacchādanaparamo viharāmi.

37932.meaning2: giving in charge, dedication, returning (of something)

examples.text: rūpā saddā rasā gandhā, phoṭṭhabbā ca manoramā, niyyātayāmi tuyh'eva, māra n'āhaṃ ten'atthikā.

37936.meaning1: who is emancipated; who is released

examples.text: kīvabahukā pana, bho ānanda, imasmiṃ dhammavinaye niyyātāro'ti? na kho, sandaka, ekaṃ'y'eva sataṃ na dve satāni na tīṇi satāni na cattāri satāni na pañca satāni, atha kho bhiyyo'va ye imasmiṃ dhammavinaye niyyātāro'ti.
tena kho pana samayena jāṇussoṇi brāhmaṇo sabbasetena vaḷavābhirathena sāvatthiyā niyyāti divādivassa. addasā kho jāṇussoṇi brāhmaṇo pilotikaṃ paribbājakaṃ dūrato'va āgacchantaṃ.
takkapariyāhataṃ samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ deseti vīmaṃs'ānucaritaṃ sayaṃpaṭibhānaṃ. yassa ca khv'āssa atthāya dhammo desito so niyyāti takkarassa sammā dukkhakkhayāyā'ti.
bhikkhu y'āyaṃ diṭṭhi ariyā niyyānikā niyyāti takkarassa sammā dukkhakkhayāya tathārūpāya diṭṭhiyā diṭṭhisāmaññagato viharati sabrahmacārīsu āvi c'eva raho ca

37939.meaning2: given into charge, given over, assigned, dedicated

examples.text: atha kho nando gopālako sāmikānaṃ gāvo niyyātetvā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, niyyātitā, bhante, sāmikānaṃ gāvo.

37940.meaning1: wanting to go out (to); wanting to leave (for)

examples.text: idha mayaṃ, bhante, yadā rājā pasenadi kosalo uyyānabhūmiṃ niyyātu'kāmo hoti, ye te rañño pasenadissa kosalassa nāgā opavayhā te kappetvā, yā tā rañño pasenadissa kosalassa pajāpatiyo piyā manāpā tā ekaṃ purato ekaṃ pacchato nisīdāpema.

37941.meaning1: to go out (of); to exit; to leave

examples.text: tasmiṃ, bhikkhave, samaye rañño na phāsu hoti atiyātuṃ vā niyyātuṃ vā paccantime vā janapade anusaññātuṃ.

37942.meaning1: should be given; (comm) should be finished; should be concluded

37943.commentary: (SNa) niyyāteh'evā'ti niyyātehi'y'eva. gāvīsu hi aniyyātitāsu gosāmikā āgantvā, ekā gāvī na dissati, eko goṇo, eko vacchako na dissatī'ti tuyhaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito vicarissanti, iti te aphāsukaṃ bhavissati. pabbajjā ca nām'esā saiṇassa na ruhati, aṇaṇā pabbajjā ca buddh'ādīhi saṃvaṇṇitā'ti dassan'atthaṃ evam'āha.

examples.text: tena hi tvaṃ, nanda, sāmikānaṃ gāvo niyyātehī'ti. gamissanti, bhante, gāvo vacchagiddhiniyo'ti. niyyāteh'eva tvaṃ, nanda, sāmikānaṃ gāvo'ti.

37945.meaning1: having handed over; having delivered; having returned
37945.meaning2: having given into charge, having given over

examples.text: gopālako sāyanhasamaye sāmikānaṃ gāvo niyyātetvā iti paṭisañcikkhati, ajja kho gāvo amukasmiñ'ca amukasmiñ'ca padese cariṃsu
atha kho nando gopālako sāmikānaṃ gāvo niyyātetvā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, niyyātitā, bhante, sāmikānaṃ gāvo.

37948.meaning1: gave; assigned (something to); handed (something) into the charge (of)

examples.text: rājā cakkaratanaṃ purakkhatvā tattha agamāsi. cattāro mahārājāno mandhātumahārājā āgato'ti sutvā'va mah'iddhiko mah'ānubhāvo rājā na sakkā yuddhena paṭibāhitun'ti sakarajjaṃ niyyātesuṃ. so taṃ gahetvā puna pucchi, atthi nu kho ito ramaṇīyataraṃ ṭhānan'ti.

so tasmiṃ ambavane rattiṭṭhāna-divāṭhāna-leṇakuṭi-maṇḍap'ādīni sampādetvā bhagavato anucchavikaṃ gandhakuṭiṃ kārāpetvā ambavanaṃ aṭṭhārasahatth'ubbedhena tambapaṭṭavaṇṇena pākārena parikkhipāpetvā buddhappamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ sacīvarabhattena santappetvā dakkhiṇ'odakaṃ pātetvā vihāraṃ niyyātesi.
ehi sārathi gacchāhi, rathaṃ niyyādayāh'imaṃ, ārogyaṃ brāhmaṇiṃ vajja, pabbaji dāni brāhmaṇo, sujāto tīhi rattīhi, tisso vijjā aphassayi.

tena bhikkhunā pucchitabbā, samagg'āttha, bhaginiyo'ti? sace samagg'āmh'āyyā'ti bhaṇanti, vattanti, bhaginiyo, aṭṭha garudhammā'ti? sace vattant'āyyā'ti bhaṇanti, eso, bhaginiyo, ovādo'ti niyyādetabbo.

37953.meaning2: gives into charge, gives over, hands over

examples.text: tatiyam'pi kho so māṇavako mātusapattiṃ etadavoca, yam'idaṃ, bhoti, dhanaṃ vā dhaññaṃ vā rajataṃ vā jātarūpaṃ vā, sabbaṃ taṃ mayhaṃ, n'atthi tuyhettha kiñci. pitu me, bhoti, dāyajjaṃ niyyādehī'ti.
niṭṭhāpito may'ārāmo, sampaṭiccha tuvaṃ muni, niyyādessāmi taṃ vīra, adhivāsehi cakkhuma.

37955.meaning1: having handed over; having given (something to)
37955.meaning2: having given into charge, having given over

examples.text: so ācariyassa ācariyadhanaṃ niyyādetvā kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati.

37964.commentary: (DNa) raññaṃ niyyānaṃ bhavissatī'ti asukadivase asukanakkhattena asukassa nāma rañño niggamanaṃ bhavissatī'ti evaṃ rājūnaṃ pavāsagamanaṃ byākaroti. esa nayo sabbattha.

examples.text: te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ, raññaṃ niyyānaṃ bhavissati, raññaṃ aniyyānaṃ bhavissati, abbhantarānaṃ raññaṃ upayānaṃ bhavissati
bhāvehi maggaṃ amatassa pattiyā, niyyānikaṃ sabbadukhakkhay'ogadhaṃ, aṭṭh'aṅgikaṃ sabbakilesasodhanaṃ, itissu maṃ citta pure niyuñjasi.
ye te, bhikkhave, kusalā dhammā ariyā niyyānikā sambodhagāmino, tesaṃ vo, bhikkhave, kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ariyānaṃ niyyānikānaṃ sambodhagāmīnaṃ kā upanisā savanāyā'ti

37967.commentary: (SNa) yaṃ pan'etaṃ sāvatthiyā niyyāyantan'ti vuttaṃ, tatr'āyaṃ niyyāyanavibhāvanā, so kira channaṃ channaṃ māsānaṃ ekavāraṃ nagaraṃ padakkhiṇaṃ karoti, ito ettakehi divasehi nagaraṃ padakkhiṇaṃ karissatī'ti puretaram'eva ghosanā kayirati. taṃ sutvā ye nagarato na pakkantā, te na pakkamanti. ye'pi pakkantā, te'pi puññavato sirisampattiṃ passissāmā'ti āgacchanti. yaṃ divasaṃ brāhmaṇo nagaraṃ anuvicarati, tadā pāto'va nagaravīthiyo sammajjitvā vālikaṃ okiritvā lājapañcamehi pupphehi vippakiritvā puṇṇaghaṭe ṭhapetvā kadaliyo ca dhaje ca ussāpetvā sakalanagaraṃ dhūpitavāsitaṃ karonti.

examples.text: addasā kho āyasmā ānando jāṇussoṇiṃ brāhmaṇaṃ sabbasetena vaḷavābhirathena sāvatthiyā niyyāyantaṃ.
atha kho rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto pañcasu hatthinikāsatesu paccekā itthiyo āropetvā ārohaṇīyaṃ nāgaṃ abhiruhitvā ukkāsu dhāriyamānāsu rājagahamhā niyyāsi
atha kho vesālikā licchavī bhadrāni bhadrāni yānāni yojāpetvā bhadraṃ bhadraṃ yānaṃ abhiruhitvā bhadrehi bhadrehi yānehi vesāliyā niyyāsuṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.

vejayantassa kho, mārisa moggallāna, pāsādassa ekasataṃ niyyūhaṃ. ek'ekasmiṃ niyyūhe satta satta kūṭ'āgārasatāni. ekam'ekasmiṃ kūṭ'āgāre satta satta accharāyo. ekam'ekissā accharāya satta satta paricārikāyo.
āsā yassa na vijjanti, asmiṃ loke paramhi ca, nirāsāsaṃ visaṃyuttaṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.
sāmisaṃ vā sukhaṃ vedanaṃ vedayamāno sāmisaṃ sukhaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmī'ti pajānāti, nirāmisaṃ vā sukhaṃ vedanaṃ vedayamāno nirāmisaṃ sukhaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmī'ti pajānāti.

37972.meaning2: went out; left; came out, emerged, appeared

examples.text: ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ukkhittapaligho iti'pi, saṃkiṇṇaparikkho iti'pi, abbūḷh'esiko iti'pi, niraggaḷo iti'pi, ariyo pannaddhajo pannabhāro visaṃyutto iti'pi.

37975.commentary: (SNa) ekena pariyaññena sattarasahi pasūhi yajitabbassa beluvayūpassa sattarasakadakkhiṇassa yaññass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. n'atthi ettha aggaḷā'ti niraggaḷo.

examples.text: assamedhaṃ purisamedhaṃ, sammāpāsaṃ vājapeyyaṃ niraggaḷhaṃ, mahāyaññā mah'ārambhā, na te honti mahapphalā.

37981.commentary: (THa) tattha me nirato mano'ti tasmiṃ vipassanāmagge mayhaṃ cittaṃ nirataṃ. (THIa) tattha tasmiṃ ariyadhamme mayhaṃ mano nirato abhirato, na tato vinivattatī'ti attho.

examples.text: akampiyaṃ atuliyaṃ, aputhujjanasevitaṃ, buddho dhammam'adesesi, tattha me nirato mano, tisso vijjā anuppattā, kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ.

37982.grammar: masc, atta group, from atta, neg
37982.commentary: (SNPa) attā nirattā na hi tassa atthī'ti tassa hi attadiṭṭhi vā ucchedadiṭṭhi vā n'atthi, gahaṇaṃ muñcanaṃ vā'pi attanirattasaññitaṃ n'atthi.

examples.text: upayo hi dhammesu upeti vādaṃ, anūpayaṃ kena kathaṃ vadeyya, attā nirattā na hi tassa atthi, adhosi so diṭṭhim'idh'eva sabban'ti.
na tassa puttā pasavo, khettaṃ vatthuñ'ca vijjati, attā vā'pi nirattā vā, na tasmiṃ upalabbhati.

37983.commentary: (SNPa) attā nirattā na hi tassa atthī'ti tassa hi attadiṭṭhi vā ucchedadiṭṭhi vā n'atthi, gahaṇaṃ muñcanaṃ vā'pi attanirattasaññitaṃ n'atthi.

examples.text: kāmesu vinaya gedhaṃ, nekkhammaṃ daṭṭhu khemato, uggahītaṃ nirattaṃ vā, mā te vijjittha kiñcanaṃ.
upayo hi dhammesu upeti vādaṃ, anūpayaṃ kena kathaṃ vadeyya, attaṃ nirattaṃ na hi tassa atthi, adhosi so diṭṭhim'idh'eva sabban'ti.
aciraṃ vat'ayaṃ kāyo, pathaviṃ adhisessati, chuddho apetaviññāṇo, niratthaṃ'va kaliṅgaraṃ.
yathā haritālena makkhitaṃ, addasa cittikaṃ bhittiyā kataṃ, tamhi te viparītadassanaṃ, saññā mānusikā niratthikā.

37986.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of niratthaka
37986.construction:
nir + √ar + tha + ka + aṃ
niratthaka + aṃ

37987.meaning1: without underlying tendencies; free from inherent inclinations; without dormant dispositions

examples.text: ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu niranusayo sammaddaso acchecchi taṇhaṃ, vivattayi saṃyojanaṃ, sammā mān'ābhisamayā antam'akāsi dukkhassā'ti.

37990.construction:
nir + anta + ra + aṃ
nirantara + aṃ

examples.text: rañño imaṃ pāṭihāriyaṃ passantassa pītiyā nirantaraṃ phuṭasarīrassa añjaliṃ paggahetvā ṭhitass'eva mahābodhi mūlasatena suvaṇṇakaṭāhe patiṭṭhāsi
yo sugatesu manaṃ padosaye, sataṃ sahassānaṃ nirabbudānaṃ, chattiṃsatī pañca ca abbudāni, yam'ariyagarahī nirayaṃ upeti, vācaṃ manañ'ca paṇidhāya pāpakan'ti.

37995.commentary: (VINa) nirabbudo'ti abbudavirahito, abbudā vuccanti corā, niccoro'ti attho. corā'ti ca imasmiṃ atthe dussīlā'va adhippetā. te hi assamaṇā'va hutvā samaṇapaṭiññatāya paresaṃ paccaye corenti. tasmā nirabbudo'ti niccoro, niddussīlo'ti vuttaṃ hoti. (DNa) nirabbudan'ti abbudavirahitaṃ, gumbaṃ gumbaṃ hutvā carantehi corehi virahitan'ti attho.

examples.text: parosahassaṃ kho pan'assa puttā bhavanti sūrā vīr'aṅgarūpā parasenappamaddanā. so imaṃ pathaviṃ sāgarapariyantaṃ akhilam'animittam'akaṇṭakaṃ iddhaṃ phītaṃ khemaṃ sivaṃ nirabbudaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena abhivijiya ajjhāvasati.
nirabbudo hi, sāriputta, bhikkhusaṅgho nirādīnavo apagatakāḷako suddho sāre patiṭṭhito.

37996.meaning1: (comm) part of the Avīci hell where one must stay a nirabbuda-count in duration
37996.commentary: (SNa) abbudo nirayo'ti abbudo nāma pāṭiyekko nirayo n'atthi. avīcimhi'y'eva pana abbudagaṇanāya paccitabbaṭṭhānass'etaṃ nāmaṃ. nirabbud'ādīsu'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhu, vīsati abbudā nirayā, evam'eko nirabbudanirayo. seyyathā'pi, bhikkhu, vīsati nirabbudā nirayā, evam'eko ababo nirayo.

37997.meaning1: (comm) part of the Avīci hell where one must stay a nirabbuda-count in duration
37997.commentary: (SNa) abbudo nirayo'ti abbudo nāma pāṭiyekko nirayo n'atthi. avīcimhi'y'eva pana abbudagaṇanāya paccitabbaṭṭhānass'etaṃ nāmaṃ. nirabbud'ādīsu'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhu, vīsati abbudā nirayā, evam'eko nirabbudanirayo. seyyathā'pi, bhikkhu, vīsati nirabbudā nirayā, evam'eko ababo nirayo.
yāya devā manussā ca, sitā tiṭṭhanti atthikā, tarath'etaṃ visattikaṃ, khaṇo vo mā upaccagā, khaṇ'ātītā hi socanti, nirayamhi samappitā.
abhabbo taṃ kammaṃ kātuṃ, yaṃ kammaṃ katvā nirayaṃ vā tiracchānayoniṃ vā pettivisayaṃ vā upapajjeyya, abhabbo'va tāva kālaṃ kātuṃ yāva na sot'āpattiphalaṃ sacchikaroti.
